name: protein kinase C beta

function.text: PRKCB encodes protein kinase C beta type. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and calcium,diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.

function.text: PRKCB encodes protein kinase C beta type. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction. Functional annotations also associate the protein with transcription coactivator activity and calcium,diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKCB have been reported in adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma and diffuse large b-Cell lymphoma, NOS.
